```text
Fix macOS 27.0.1 FFI builds by disabling host stripping

The macOS 14.0 deployment target makes the linker emit chained fixups.
When rustc strips host proc-macro dylibs with its bundled rust-objcopy,
it leaves the LINKEDIT string pool aligned to four bytes. dyld rejects
those dylibs on macOS 27.0.1, so clean builds fail with
"can't find crate for thiserror_impl".

Disable stripping for release-profile proc macros and build scripts
through Cargo's build override. The shipped static library targets
macOS 14.0 on both Apple Silicon and Intel.
```
